# The Granios Cafe

> The Granios Cafe is a casual establishment located in Nizamabad, Telangana, offering a variety of coffee, shakes, fast food, and light snacks. It provides a suitable setting for quick bites and casual gatherings.

## Menu
A casual cafe offering a range of coffee, shakes, fast food, and light snacks suitable for quick bites and gatherings.
